# Matthew Lehman Media

> Sports and athletic photography in Logan, Ohio, covering Logan Hocking School
> District athletics and AFJROTC events. Founded 2025 by Matthew Lehman, a
> self-employed photographer and student.

Game-day action, recruiting portraits and full team sessions. Finished galleries
are published on this site; clients receive private galleries by link.

## Pages

- [Home](https://www.matthewlehmanmedia.com/): who I am, what I shoot, packages, and the contact form.
- [Galleries](https://www.matthewlehmanmedia.com/gallery): every public gallery, searchable and filtered by sport.

## What is covered

- Baseball — full 2026 season, game by game
- Soccer and volleyball — 2026-2027 season
- Tennis — 2026 matches
- AFJROTC and Raider Challenge — meets, drill competitions, Fort Knox, Columbus Crew game

## Contact

Enquiries go through the contact form on the home page. Based in Logan, Ohio.

## Notes for crawlers

- Gallery pages are rendered client-side from a database; individual galleries
  are fragments (`/gallery#gallery-<slug>`) rather than separate URLs.
- `/admin`, `/login`, and private gallery links (`/g/<secret>`) are not public
  and are excluded in robots.txt.
